# CallableMethodValidity

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> 

Group: [Probable bugs](/rules/#probable-bugs) · PhpStorm name: `CallableMethodValidityInspection`

`is_callable()` on a method callback that names a non-public method, or a
non-static method without an object, describes a callback that cannot really
be invoked from the outside (or will break when invoked statically). Flag the
argument so the method's visibility/static-ness gets fixed.

## Example

```php{15,16,17,22,23}
<?php
class Shop
{
    public function open() {}
    protected function audit() {}
    public static function hours() {}
    private static function vault() {}
}

function probe(Shop $shop)
{
    $handler = ['Shop', 'open'];
    return [
        is_callable('ucfirst'),
        is_callable([Shop::class, 'open']),
        is_callable('Shop::open'),
        is_callable($handler),
        is_callable(['Shop', 'hours']),
        is_callable('Shop::hours'),
        is_callable([$shop, 'open']),
        is_callable([$shop, 'hours']),
        is_callable([$shop, 'audit']),
        is_callable([Shop::class, 'vault']),
        is_callable(['Shop::open']),
        is_callable([$shop, 'missing']),
    ];
}
```

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 15: Method &#39;open&#39; is not static but is referenced without an object.</li>
<li>line 16: Method &#39;open&#39; is not static but is referenced without an object.</li>
<li>line 17: Method &#39;open&#39; is not static but is referenced without an object.</li>
<li>line 22: Method &#39;audit&#39; is not public, so the callback cannot be invoked from outside.</li>
<li>line 23: Method &#39;vault&#39; is not public, so the callback cannot be invoked from outside.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "CallableMethodValidity": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore CallableMethodValidity

/**
 * @noinspection CallableMethodValidityInspection
 */
```
